integrity: Finite direct-spin and grouped checks support, but do not replace, the analytic all-n all-real-field proof; no numerical extrapolation or independence claim.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three equal labeled parts, homogeneous antiferromagnetic Ising couplings, real unscaled longitudinal field; weak one-spin energy stability is not dynamical trapping. No unequal-part, multi-spin, finite-temperature or positive-barrier theorem. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Field-resonant weak minima and parity-alternating complexity on complete tripartite Ising networks
